description: Manages packages with urpmi (such as for Mageia or Mandriva).

parameters.name: force
parameters.description: Assume “yes” is the answer to any question urpmi has to ask. Corresponds to the --force option for urpmi. Choices: false true ← (default)

parameters.name: name
parameters.description: A list of package names to install, upgrade or remove.

parameters.name: no_recommends
parameters.description: Corresponds to the --no-recommends option for urpmi. Choices: false true ← (default)

parameters.name: root
parameters.description: Specifies an alternative install root, relative to which all packages are installed. Corresponds to the --root option for urpmi.

parameters.name: state
parameters.description: Indicates the desired package state. Choices: "absent" "present" ← (default) "installed" "removed"

parameters.name: update_cache
parameters.description: Update the package database first urpmi.update -a. Choices: false ← (default) true

examples:
- name: Install package foo
  community.general.urpmi:
    pkg: foo
    state: present

- name: Remove package foo
  community.general.urpmi:
    pkg: foo
    state: absent

- name: Remove packages foo and bar
  community.general.urpmi:
    pkg: foo,bar
    state: absent

- name: Update the package database (urpmi.update -a -q) and install bar (bar will be the updated if a newer version exists)
- community.general.urpmi:
    name: bar
    state: present
    update_cache: true
